notes.title: Hotfix 0.1
notes.content:
Hotfix 0.1 is live right now! The amount of bugs is far less than expected so here is the first small patch already!

[list]
[*] Removed an enemy on level 18
[*] Small text issues resolved
[*] Added a button to skip to the next music track [M]
[*] Made the quit more direct
[*] Added more blood ːsteammockingː
[/list]

Thank you all for the support! I hope you have a good day and enjoy Contract!

-Sylvain
